about: Example: the fly brain templates JRC2018F (Bogovic et al. 2020) as fixed and FCWB (Costa et al. 2016) as moving, from the OME-NGFF transformation examples. As stored, FCWB is about half as deep and sits elsewhere.
published_about: the published affine: the affine part of the JRC2018F-to-FCWB transform in the same examples, where a displacement field of its own comes first
